title: Shops and quick snacks
summary: Prime Mart for hostel essentials, the Shopping Complex, stalls near Raman Block.

posts.md:
Need groceries, hostel essentials, stationery, or a quick snack? Here are the most useful shopping spots inside IIT Madras.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Prime Mart**  *Most Recommended*

Prime Mart is the go-to store for almost every IIT Madras student. It's the best place to buy daily essentials after moving into your hostel.

You'll find:

Personal Care
- Soaps
- Shampoo
- Toothpaste
- Toiletries

Hostel Essentials
- Pillows
- Bedsheets
- Buckets
- Mugs
- Hangers
- Cleaning supplies

Food & Drinks
- Packed snacks
- Instant noodles
- Biscuits
- Chocolates
- Cool drinks
- Ice creams

Stationery
- Pens
- Notebooks
- Books
- Files

Electronics & Accessories
- LAN Routers
- LAN Cables
- Mobile accessories
- Other daily-use items

**Senior Tip:** If you forgot to pack something from home, check Prime Mart first—there's a good chance you'll find it here.

https://maps.app.goo.gl/jFiAcLjoouL79EZ89
**Shopping Complex**

You'll find:

- Grocery Store
- Dairy Products
- Fruits & Vegetables
- Stationery
- Tailor Shop
- Gift Shop
- Ladies' Parlour

https://maps.app.goo.gl/6qDmji242nJJDw9h6
**Near Raman Block**

Several small shops selling:

- Sugarcane Juice
- Coconut Water
- Chips & Snacks
- Dry Fruits (at night)
